correctness.rationale: All seven neighborhood sets are derived from explicit gap bounds on the entire invariant coefficient rectangle; row averaging gives exactly \(u\mapsto-u/6\) and \(v\mapsto v/2\). Inclusive equality \(v\ge3u\) handles boundary rays and discrete threshold curves. At odd times the arcs are included, while even instants have a monotone criterion \(b\ge3a9^{-j}\). This proves both the exact first permanent graph time \(T=2\lceil\log_9(3a/b)\rceil-1\) and the total number of changes, with separate constant and nonfreezing cases. Exact planar integration proves the distribution, and a symbolic geometric series proves the mean \(29/24\). A standalone exact-rational script passed 73 cases and 4818 updates; the infinite theorem rests on proof, not testing.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 result leaves finite perturbative graph-switching complexity unresolved. The invariant two-eigenmode plane provides a natural complete phase diagram showing that all finite odd switching counts occur, that arbitrarily long finite transients accumulate along the nonfreezing boundary, and that duration diverges on an exact logarithmic scale. A precise area-tail law further quantifies frequency of these metastable transients under a natural uniform parameterization. This directly distinguishes finite observation from true infinite-time nonfreezing and is not merely a renaming of the source counterexample.
